pairs.source_text:
MERGE etl.CountryRegion AS t
USING (VALUES ('IN', N'India',                N'APAC'),
              ('SG', N'Singapore',            N'APAC'),
              ('AU', N'Australia',            N'APAC'),
              ('JP', N'Japan',                N'APAC'),
              ('US', N'United States',        N'NA'),
              ('CA', N'Canada',               N'NA'),
              ('GB', N'United Kingdom',       N'EMEA'),
              ('DE', N'Germany',              N'EMEA'),
              ('FR', N'France',               N'EMEA'),
              ('AE', N'United Arab Emirates', N'EMEA'),
              ('BR', N'Brazil',               N'LATAM'),
              ('MX', N'Mexico',               N'LATAM')) AS s (CountryCode, Country, Region)
ON t.CountryCode = s.CountryCode
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET Country = s.Country, Region = s.Region
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CountryCode, Country, Region) VALUES (s.CountryCode, s.Country, s.Region)

             ('SG', 'Singapore', 'APAC'),
             ('AU', 'Australia', 'APAC'),
             ('JP', 'Japan', 'APAC'),
             ('US', 'United States', 'NA'),
             ('CA', 'Canada', 'NA'),
             ('GB', 'United Kingdom', 'EMEA'),
             ('DE', 'Germany', 'EMEA'),
             ('FR', 'France', 'EMEA'),
             ('AE', 'United Arab Emirates', 'EMEA'),
             ('BR', 'Brazil', 'LATAM'),
             ('MX', 'Mexico', 'LATAM')) AS s (
   CountryCode,
   Country,
   Region
)
ON t.CountryCode = s.CountryCode
WHEN MATCHED THEN
   UPDATE SET
      Country = s.Country,
      Region = s.Region
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
   INSERT (CountryCode, Country, Region) VALUES (s.CountryCode, s.Country, s.Region)
